The hospital capacity risk calculation succeeded with a perfect reward score, validating the core logic and integration.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.94 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.31s. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check edge cases in the weighted-risk formula to maintain the high reward signal.
